name: 医疗健康数据概念与证据边界 / healthcare domain knowledge
license: MIT (original project curation; third-party sources retain their terms)
scope: Database-neutral ontology/data design for patient-context request/event/result/provenance records
authority: Onto Skills original data-modeling guidance; no clinical, regulatory or FHIR conformance authority
baseline: HL7 FHIR R4 4.0.1 is deliberately pinned for this mapping. R5 is a different published release; development builds are not the baseline.

concepts.name: 患者标识与资源身份
concepts.summary: Patient resource identifies a source-system record, not a globally unique person. Keep source server/type/id separate from a tenant-scoped synthetic patient pseudonym. Cross-source association needs authorized identifier crosswalk evidence; matching names, demographics or shared contact is insufficient.
concepts.modeling_decision: Keep Patient pseudonym and evidence-bearing identity links separate. A missing or rejected link leaves the record unresolved; no automatic merge.
concepts.standard_gap: 跨来源患者归并、授权crosswalk与假名键是本地策略；Identifier相同或人口信息相似本身不授予身份合并。

standard_basis.scope: 资源逻辑ID具有资源/服务上下文。
业务标识的system/value与资源逻辑ID区分。

concepts.name: 资源版本与重复导入
concepts.summary: Resource logical identity includes its source endpoint and resource type/id. meta.versionId denotes a record version, not a sortable number, clinical event, terminology version or FHIR release. Source history availability is not guaranteed.
concepts.modeling_decision: Keep immutable version snapshots. Exact version replay is idempotent; new versions and separate event ids survive. Resolve current state from an authoritative source claim, never lexical or numeric version sorting.
concepts.standard_gap: 本地版本去重和快照保留为设计选择；meta.versionId不是可依赖的数值排序，也不保证来源开放历史。

standard_basis.scope: 版本元数据与资源逻辑身份分离，版本ID是来源管理的标识。

concepts.name: 就诊上下文
concepts.summary: Encounter supplies interaction context and has its own lifecycle; local systems differ in encounter granularity. A planned or repeated encounter is not an interchangeable patient row.
concepts.modeling_decision: Use encounter source identity. Keep a repeat visit separate even for the same patient and code. Do not infer clinical completion from a finished encounter.
concepts.standard_gap: 本地资源投影、关联键、证据筛选、缺失/冲突处理及授权策略不是完整FHIR profile、术语绑定或临床验证。

standard_basis.scope: Encounter提供患者与服务交互的上下文及生命周期。

concepts.name: 医嘱请求与实际执行
concepts.summary: ServiceRequest models a requested service with intent and request status. Procedure models activity documentation with its own status. R4 request cancellation is represented by revoked; this alone supplies no performed event. Preserve doNotPerform: a prohibition request is not a positive request to carry out the named service.
concepts.modeling_decision: Link explicit basedOn references. Never manufacture Procedure from Order. Count completed procedures under the fixture policy; retain not-done, entered-in-error and other states for audit without counting completed activity. A later revoked order does not erase an independently evidenced completed procedure.
concepts.standard_gap: 本地资源投影、关联键、证据筛选、缺失/冲突处理及授权策略不是完整FHIR profile、术语绑定或临床验证。

standard_basis.scope: 请求意图及禁止执行含义。
执行活动文档有独立状态。
请求撤销状态不证明实际执行。

concepts.name: 观测结果有效性与缺失
concepts.summary: Observation status modifies how a result is interpreted. entered-in-error invalidates that resource as usable evidence; absence of a result is not a negative finding. A dataAbsentReason can describe missing value.
concepts.modeling_decision: The example quantitative view admits only current final/amended/corrected numerical quantities with known coding and units. This eligibility rule is local policy, not a clinical validity judgment. Unknown and preliminary remain explicit; never label an unassessed value normal.
concepts.standard_gap: 本地资源投影、关联键、证据筛选、缺失/冲突处理及授权策略不是完整FHIR profile、术语绑定或临床验证。

standard_basis.scope: 结果状态与缺失原因字段。
录入错误状态的含义。

concepts.name: 健康问题与诊断断言
concepts.summary: Condition carries a recorded concern or assessment; clinicalStatus and verificationStatus have different meanings. Recorded assertions may be unconfirmed or refuted and should not be promoted to confirmed diagnoses.
concepts.modeling_decision: Do not derive Condition from a numerical threshold. Preserve source status and authoring context. Check con-4/con-5 where relevant, without claiming complete FHIR validation.
concepts.standard_gap: 本地资源投影、关联键、证据筛选、缺失/冲突处理及授权策略不是完整FHIR profile、术语绑定或临床验证。

standard_basis.scope: 确认状态与临床状态有不同语义。

concepts.name: 临床时间与记录时间
concepts.summary: Order authoredOn, requested occurrence, Procedure performed[x], Observation effective[x]/issued, Condition onset/recordedDate and Provenance recorded describe different clocks. Server lastUpdated is another clock.
concepts.modeling_decision: Keep original choice type, precision, interval and timezone. Do not invent midnight or substitute ingestion time for an unknown clinical time. Project recorded_at means intake time and is labeled separately.
concepts.standard_gap: 本地时间字段投影必须保留来源精度和choice类型；缺失值不补造午夜，观测截止策略由项目定义。

standard_basis.scope: 请求签发时间。
执行时间或期间。
观测有效时间与可用时间分离。
健康问题发生时间与记录日期分离。
来源活动记录时间。

concepts.name: 术语与单位
concepts.summary: Coding meaning is contextual to system, version and code; display text is not a key. Quantity includes the value and potentially comparator plus a unit label and coded unit system/code.
concepts.modeling_decision: Keep code-system version and original units. Missing version remains unknown. Do not aggregate unlike versions or units by display name. Any approved conversion needs a traceable rule and original value retained; the fixture performs none.
concepts.standard_gap: 单位换算和代码等价须另有获准规则；display或unit标签相同不证明代码、量纲或术语版本相同。

standard_basis.scope: 编码system/version/code及Quantity的数值、comparator与单位字段。

concepts.name: 证据、撤回与授权边界
concepts.summary: Provenance can describe how a resource version was created or revised. It does not itself establish an authorization to read or disclose a patient record, nor prove that a medical activity occurred.
concepts.modeling_decision: Attach provenance to exact versions. Source status invalidation or an authorized, version-specific retraction policy excludes a view without destroying audit history. Apply purpose/access checks before any data release; this package offers no security runtime or compliance claim.
concepts.standard_gap: Provenance不是访问授权或临床行为发生的证明；本地撤回筛选与权限运行机制未由此实现。

standard_basis.scope: 资源创建/更新的来源活动及目标资源。

concepts.name: 合成数据最小化
concepts.summary: These fixtures use invented patient pseudonyms, invalid example domains and local synthetic codes; they contain no patient facts or care instructions.
concepts.modeling_decision: Request the smallest authorized, de-identified schema and examples. Keep real identity crosswalks and secrets outside prompts and examples. A pseudonym alone is not a guarantee that data are anonymous.
concepts.standard_gap: 合成样例、最小化输入和假名保护是项目规则；本包不提供匿名性、隐私合规或授权运行时证明。

concepts.name: 业务标识命名空间与有效期
concepts.summary: FHIR Identifier has use, type, system, value, period and assigner. Preserve its namespace and validity separately from the resource logical id and from local patient pseudonyms; the issuing organization is not the same field as the identifier value.
concepts.modeling_decision: Store identifier_system/value/use/period/assigner as supplied; an absent system or assigner remains unresolved rather than becoming a global identity key.

standard_basis.scope: Identifier的命名空间、值、用途、期间及分配机构字段。

concepts.standard_gap: 本地跨系统匹配与患者假名关联仍需授权证据；这些字段本身不构成匹配或身份合并算法。

concepts.name: 数量比较符与测量边界
concepts.summary: Quantity.comparator can express a bound such as less than or greater than. A reported value with a comparator is not an exact point measurement; retain comparator, value, display unit and coded unit system/code together.
concepts.modeling_decision: Keep missing numeric value distinct from zero and preserve comparator when projecting or displaying the observation. Do not average a bound as if it were an exact measurement or infer unit equivalence by label.

standard_basis.scope: Quantity的comparator修饰数值解释，unit标签与system/code分离。

concepts.standard_gap: 聚合策略、单位转换和临床解释为外部授权规则；本包不输出诊断、治疗或全量Quantity验证器。

official_constraints.name: Observation missing-value exclusivity
official_constraints.rule: For the Observation root value, dataAbsentReason is allowed only when value[x] is absent (obs-6). Components require their own mapping review.

standard_basis.scope: root value[x]存在时不能另有dataAbsentReason；只覆盖此选定不变量。

official_constraints.name: Condition entered-in-error boundary
official_constraints.rule: A Condition with verificationStatus entered-in-error must omit clinicalStatus (con-5). This is a selected rule, not a complete resource validator.

standard_basis.scope: verificationStatus=entered-in-error时clinicalStatus应缺失；只覆盖此选定不变量。

mapping_losses.name: 资源覆盖损失
mapping_losses.detail: Model preserves selected typed fields plus an authorized source snapshot. It does not model all cardinalities, extensions/modifierExtensions, profiles, references, consent, signatures, terminology bindings or workflow semantics. Retaining raw JSON does not implement their meaning.
mapping_losses.standard_gap: 保留JSON或少量字段不实现全部FHIR语义、modifierExtensions、profiles、references、consent、签名及工作流。

standard_basis.scope: 基础资源提供广于本地模型的结构背景。

mapping_losses.name: 术语映射边界
mapping_losses.detail: No ICD, LOINC or SNOMED CT files/code lists are bundled. Example clinical codes are local synthetic identifiers with explicit system and version; no equivalence to licensed clinical terminology is asserted.
mapping_losses.standard_gap: 本包不包含或验证ICD、LOINC、SNOMED CT代码集；本地合成编码不声明与临床标准术语等价。

standard_basis.scope: 编码来源system/version/code边界。

standard_gap: 项目维护的知识集合、版本和范围说明；组织方式不是外部标准规定。
